info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Preapprovals-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Preapproval Listing API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of preapproved mortgage loans. This functionality is essential for homeowners and lenders looking to understand available financing options. Typical consumers include mortgage brokers, financial advisors, and real estate agents who need access to preapproval data for their clients. By utilizing this API, users can efficiently access key loan details to facilitate informed decision-making in the home buying process.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the preapproval status for a loan application. It allows users to check if they are eligible for a loan before proceeding with the application process.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a loan preapproval process. Ensure all required fields are provided as per the defined schema for a successful preapproval request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and preapproval details are returned.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to loan preapproval. It is expected to be a string representing relevant information in JSON format.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.title: Preapproval Response

status.description: Indicates whether the preapproval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the preapproval request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the preapproval operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message or information about the preapproval request.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.description: Response schema for preapproval operations, containing the status and details related to the preapproval request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the preapproval request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the preapproval request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the preapproval request was processed by an automated system.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the auditing of the preapproval request.

schema.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
